I need to analyze a PowerPoint file at `/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx` to understand its structure and identify all paper titles.

Please:
1. Use Python with python-pptx library to open the file
2. Iterate through all slides and identify text boxes with paper titles (look for titles that might be "dangling" - not properly formatted or positioned)
3. Extract all unique paper titles from the presentation
4. Report the structure you find (number of slides, titles found, current formatting)

Print the findings so I can understand what needs to be processed.

input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
from pptx import Presentation
import os

# Check if file exists
file_path = '/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx'
if not os.path.exists(file_path):
    print(f"Error: File not found at {file_path}")
    exit(1)

# Open the presentation
prs = Presentation(file_path)

print("=" * 80)
print("POWERPOINT ANALYSIS: Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx")
print("=" * 80)

print(f"\nTotal Slides: {len(prs.slides)}")
print(f"Slide Dimensions: {prs.slide_width} x {prs.slide_height}")

all_titles = []
slide_details = []

# Iterate through all slides
for slide_idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides, 1):
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"SLIDE {slide_idx}")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    
    slide_info = {
        'slide_number': slide_idx,
        'shapes': [],
        'titles': []
    }
    
    # Iterate through shapes in the slide
    for shape_idx, shape in enumerate(slide.shapes):
        shape_info = {
            'name': shape.name,
            'shape_type': str(shape.shape_type),
            'has_text': shape.has_text_frame,
            'text': None,
            'position': None
        }
        
        print(f"\nShape {shape_idx}: {shape.name}")
        print(f"  Type: {shape.shape_type}")
        print(f"  Has Text Frame: {shape.has_text_frame}")
        
        # If shape has text, extract it
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            text_frame = shape.text_frame
            full_text = text_frame.text
            shape_info['text'] = full_text
            
            if full_text.strip():
                print(f"  Text Content: {full_text[:100]}")
                if len(full_text) > 100:
                    print(f"           ... (total length: {len(full_text)})")
                
                # Check if this might be a title (text-heavy, not too short, not too long)
                words = len(full_text.split())
                print(f"  Word Count: {words}")
                
                # Store potential titles
                if 3 <= words <= 50:  # Reasonable title length
                    all_titles.append(full_text)
                    slide_info['titles'].append(full_text)
        
        # Check position information
        if hasattr(shape, 'left') and hasattr(shape, 'top'):
            position = f"Left: {shape.left}, Top: {shape.top}"
            shape_info['position'] = position
            print(f"  Position: {position}")
        
        slide_info['shapes'].append(shape_info)
    
    slide_details.append(slide_info)

print(f"\n{'='*80}")
print("SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*80}")

print(f"\nTotal Slides: {len(prs.slides)}")
print(f"Potential Paper Titles Found: {len(all_titles)}")
print(f"Unique Titles: {len(set(all_titles))}")

print(f"\n{'='*80}")
print("ALL EXTRACTED TITLES:")
print(f"{'='*80}")

for idx, title in enumerate(set(all_titles), 1):
    print(f"\n{idx}. {title}")

EOF

source /tmp/pptx_env/bin/activate && python3 << 'EOF'
from pptx import Presentation

file_path = '/root/Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx'
prs = Presentation(file_path)

print("=" * 90)
print("POWERPOINT STRUCTURE ANALYSIS: Awesome-Agent-Papers.pptx")
print("=" * 90)

print(f"\nTOTAL SLIDES: {len(prs.slides)}\n")

# Analyze paper titles
papers = []

for slide_idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides, 1):
    print(f"{'─'*90}")
    print(f"SLIDE {slide_idx}")
    print(f"{'─'*90}")
    
    slide_title = None
    paper_title = None
    description = None
    
    # Extract key information from shapes
    for shape in slide.shapes:
        if shape.has_text_frame:
            text = shape.text_frame.text.strip()
            shape_name = shape.name
            
            # Identify the type of text based on shape properties
            if "Title" in shape_name and text:
                # This is likely the slide title
                slide_title = text
                print(f"Slide Title: {slide_title}")
            
            elif "TextBox" in shape_name or "文本框" in shape_name:
                # This is likely the actual paper title (dangling textbox)
                if text and len(text.split()) <= 15:  # Paper titles are usually shorter
                    paper_title = text
                    print(f"Paper Title (in TextBox): {paper_title}")
            
            elif "Content" in shape_name and text:
                # This is likely the description
                if len(text) > 50:
                    description = text[:100] + "..." if len(text) > 100 else text
                    print(f"Description: {description}")
    
    if paper_title or slide_title:
        papers.append({
            'slide': slide_idx,
            'slide_title': slide_title,
            'paper_title': paper_title,
            'description': description
        })
    
    print()

print("=" * 90)
print("EXTRACTED PAPER TITLES")
print("=" * 90)

# Filter out the title slide and get actual paper titles
actual_papers = [p for p in papers if p['slide'] > 1]

for idx, paper in enumerate(actual_papers, 1):
    title = paper['paper_title'] or paper['slide_title']
    print(f"\n{idx}. {title}")
    if paper['description']:
        print(f"   Description: {paper['description']}")

print("\n" + "=" * 90)
print("STRUCTURE FINDINGS")
print("=" * 90)

print(f"\nSlide 1: Title slide ('{papers[0]['slide_title']}')")
print(f"Slides 2-6: Paper content slides ({len(actual_papers)} papers)")
print(f"\nFormatting Pattern Observed:")
print(f"  - Slide Title: Short name in placeholder (e.g., 'Foam - Agent', 'ReAct')")
print(f"  - Paper Title: Full title in TextBox (e.g., 'Foam-Agent: Towards Automated Intelligent CFD Workflows')")
print(f"  - Description: Content in content placeholder")
print(f"\n'Dangling' TextBoxes Found: Yes")
print(f"  - TextBoxes contain the complete paper titles")
print(f"  - These appear to be positioned separately from the main placeholder titles")
print(f"  - This suggests papers might need formatting standardization")

print(f"\n" + "=" * 90)
print("COMPLETE LIST OF PAPER TITLES")
print("=" * 90)

paper_titles = [p['paper_title'] for p in actual_papers if p['paper_title']]
for idx, title in enumerate(paper_titles, 1):
    print(f"\n{idx}. {title}")

EOF
